description: A Stripe Checkout link that puts this account on Solo; give it to the account's owner. Works after the trial has ended, when every other call answers requires_solo. Works on Free and after the trial has ended: this is the call to make after a 403 requires_solo. The link is a hosted Stripe page for the account's owner to complete; calls work again as soon as they pay. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

interval.description: Which Solo price the session is for.

promotionCode.description: A Stripe promotion code to apply, such as a launch code the person was given; without one the Checkout page offers its own code field.

name: get_checkout_link
title: Get checkout link
